metric_policy.complete_package_note: Complete package includes generated MBIST wrappers, algorithms, saboteur/model RTL, and staged SRAM behavioral models.
metric_policy.storage_note: Unpacked behavioral memory arrays are reported as memory_bit_count, not flipflop_count.

registers.name: CFG_REFERENCE_STREAM_VELOCITY_MPS_LO
registers.description: Low byte of cfg_reference_stream_velocity_mps fixed-point reference value. Default reset corresponds to 38.89 m/s via DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON reset value 0x0999.

fields.name: VALUE
fields.description: Bits [7:0] of the 16-bit reference stream velocity fixed-point configuration.

registers.name: CFG_REFERENCE_STREAM_VELOCITY_MPS_HI
registers.description: High byte of cfg_reference_stream_velocity_mps fixed-point reference value.

fields.name: VALUE
fields.description: Bits [15:8] of the 16-bit reference stream velocity fixed-point configuration.

registers.name: CFG_GEOMETRY_PROVENANCE_TAG
registers.description: Geometry provenance tag identifying the STL-derived DrivAerML reference geometry format selection.

fields.name: VALUE
fields.description: 8-bit geometry provenance tag forwarded into request payloads.

registers.name: CFG_WATCHDOG_THRESHOLD_LO
registers.description: Low byte of the request watchdog threshold in cycles or equivalent age units.

registers.name: CFG_WATCHDOG_THRESHOLD_HI
registers.description: High byte of the request watchdog threshold in cycles or equivalent age units.

registers.name: CFG_FRESHNESS_THRESHOLD_LO
registers.description: Low byte of the response freshness threshold in cycles or equivalent age units.

registers.name: CFG_FRESHNESS_THRESHOLD_HI
registers.description: High byte of the response freshness threshold in cycles or equivalent age units.

registers.name: CFG_SAFE_ACTUATOR_CMD_0
registers.description: Byte 0 of the predefined safe fallback actuator command.

registers.name: CFG_SAFE_ACTUATOR_CMD_1
registers.description: Byte 1 of the predefined safe fallback actuator command.

registers.name: CFG_SAFE_ACTUATOR_CMD_2
registers.description: Byte 2 of the predefined safe fallback actuator command.

registers.name: CFG_SAFE_ACTUATOR_CMD_3
registers.description: Byte 3 of the predefined safe fallback actuator command.

registers.name: CFG_ACTUATOR_MIN_0
registers.description: Byte 0 of the actuator minimum clamp bound.
